nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

**The song input starts bypassed (purple), so Text to music runs right away.** For **Cover (your song)**, un-bypass (select + Ctrl+B) **Your song** and load an audio file. **Keep it bypassed when you are not using it**: ComfyUI checks the file of every active loader before a run.

| Mode | Uses | RTX 3060 (a ~1:40-1:55 song) |
|---|---|---|
| Text to music, ABC planning on | style + lyrics | 58 s (song 1:47) |
| Text to music, ABC planning off | style + lyrics | 40 s (song 1:38) |
| Cover (your song) | your song + new style + lyrics | 51 s (song 1:40) |

If you pick Cover and Your song is still bypassed, the run stops at **Cover needs your song** (SheetSage2) before YuE2 loads.

**ABC planning** (text to music): YuE2 first writes the melody and chords as an ABC score, then sings the song from it. The score is shown in **ABC score used** - you can copy it, edit it and reuse it.
**Max length (s)** is only a cap: the length comes from your lyrics (with 120 s or 240 s I got the same song).
**Lyrics**: put [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge] tags above the sections, as in the example.
32 steps, dpm_2 / sgm_uniform, CFG 1, no negative: the official templates' settings.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

nodes.title: Downloads
widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/YuE2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| all modes | `checkpoints/` | [yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/main/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 4.0 GB |
| Cover mode | `audio_encoders/` | [sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/main/audio_encoders/sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors) | 1.4 GB |

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.39.2._

The bf16 checkpoint (`yue2_3b_bf16`, 7.8 GB) works too, pick it in the Model field. No custom nodes: core ComfyUI **0.39 or newer** (YuE2 support). YuE2 and SheetSage2: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).
